evidence_excerpts: Official standards of practice for MBSR exclude suicidality and the presence of any psychiatric disorder, with case-by-case exceptions requiring adequate medical treatment or sufficient clinical training by the instructor.

The American Psychiatric Association, the U.S. National Institutes of Health, and leading researchers have expressed concerns that meditation may be contraindicated under several circumstances, including schizophrenia spectrum disorders, bipolar disorder, post-traumatic stress disorder, depression, and risk factors for psychosis.
text: Mindfulness and meditation practices can be contraindicated for some psychiatric conditions and vulnerable populations without appropriate clinical monitoring.
